variants.headline: Still in view: builder left unpaid for work done
variants.sub: The builder {builder} is owed payment by the client {client} for completed work.
variants.body:
The client {client} has not paid {builder} for building work done. Coverage of this story continues; the original event remains the starting point for the questions examined here.

Work done is work that deserves a serious account of payment. Labour finds the stewardship of {target} wanting; ordinary people deserve a more responsible standard of conduct.
